name: Water Gate
brief: A gate in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt by Nehemiah
short: The Water Gate, one of the gates in Jerusalem's wall, rebuilt by Nehemiah and associated with the reading of the Law and the celebration of the Feast of Tabernacles (<ref="Neh. 3:26; 8:1, 3, 16; 12:37">Neh. 3:26; 8:1, 3, 16; 12:37</ref>).
